name: Megan
source: Meghan is a bit naive and can be tricked easily. She is used to being pampered, and she is the youngest in her family. She doesn't really like being a cheerleader, but enjoys the popularity involved. As a child, her parents would bring her to the theater, this implanted the dream of performing on stage.
